howItWorks.title: How PrepIQ Works <gold>Every Day</gold>
howItWorks.subtitle: Three phases, one continuous loop. Plan the day, coordinate the line, and learn from every service — so your kitchen runs a little tighter each day.

plan.label: Plan
plan.title: The morning plan
plan.body: Before your kitchen opens, PrepIQ forecasts demand and turns it into a plan your team can act on — prep quantities with confidence scores, the ingredients to buy, and a staff schedule that matches the day.

live.label: Coordinate
live.title: Coordinate the line
live.body: When the plan is locked, PrepIQ turns it into assigned tasks on a live board, tracks sales as service runs, and flags anything trending toward a stockout — so the team stays ahead of the rush.

review.label: Improve
review.title: Improve every service
review.body: After service, PrepIQ reviews what actually happened — what missed forecast and why, separating demand surprises from operational causes. Every override and outcome sharpens tomorrow's plan.

chefOverride.title: Chef Override
chefOverride.body: Your team can always adjust quantities. When they do, PrepIQ instantly shows the risk: potential waste cost, stockout probability, and profit upside. The AI learns from every override to improve tomorrow's forecast.

hero.headline: Building the <gold>operational intelligence layer</gold> for professional kitchens.

hero.mission: Help every kitchen waste less, prepare smarter, and become more predictable every single day.

story.heading: Why <gold>PrepIQ</gold> exists
story.p1: Restaurants make hundreds of operational decisions every day, yet many still rely on spreadsheets, intuition, and disconnected systems.
story.p2: We built PrepIQ to bridge that gap. Rather than replacing chefs or existing POS systems, PrepIQ acts as an intelligence layer — learning from kitchen operations, forecasting demand, reducing waste, and helping teams make better decisions before problems happen.
story.p3: Every day a kitchen uses PrepIQ, it becomes a little smarter.
